about: Results missing from the circuit record, filled from the Trial Competition Performance Rankings (TCPR) spreadsheet. Only gaps are filled: a result is added only where the record has no result for that school at that competition and the slot is open. Nothing that conflicts with the record is changed, and nothing before Spring 2023 is added. Every row added here is marked source: TCPR in the app data.
